_drop_band: Tier C (spec #447 table, owner call): El Nath is progression step 10; ordinary drops come from reqLevel 55-65, bosses from the top third of the band.
_level_scale: Tier C (spec #449 C0 first draft, untuned; game/tools/level_scale_draft.gd --step=10 --stage=el_nath): E_sw(t) is Sleepywood's effective level at each keyframe time (9.15, 9.73, 10.80, 22.22, 36.44, 48.23, 56.85); region step 10 sets level(t) = E_sw(t) + 3 x (10 - 5) = E_sw + 15 and exp_level(t) = E_sw(t), so the character levels at Sleepywood's pace and monsters are fifteen effective levels harder. Replaces an opening ramp (none here).
_tier: Tier A: map IDs, original_life, widths and rosters from v83 Map.wz and Mob.wz (docs/research/v83-region-maps.md). Tier C (owner, spec #449 C5 #467): region, map order, boss schedule, pool rules and weights, level_scale and boss multipliers (the first draft of game/tools/level_scale_draft.gd, untuned); the numeric curve (keyframe rate/max_alive/hp/speed, bursts, elites, exp_mult, hard_cap, post_duration_slope) copies Sleepywood exactly, and `level_scale` replaces its opening ramp. decHP 10 (cold damage) and fs (ice friction) on the two snow maps are ignored (tier C, as OctoPirate's limiter in #264): movement is unchanged. Snow Witch has contact damage and Banish only, Riche one magic attack with Banish and its heal, Snowman a ball attack with Stun, the poison mist and its Jr. Yeti summons; ordinary mobs cast no mob skills (owner, #76).
name: Icy Path
_bosses: Tier C: first-draft multipliers from game/tools/level_scale_draft.gd --step=10 --stage=el_nath (spec #449 C0), untuned; 8 s per-attack cadence as every boss.
